name: DR Congo (east)
value: FRN took Bulambika 8 Nov; no major city fallen
summary: FRN fighters took Bulambika in South Kivu on 8 Nov and the army plans a counter-offensive; no major city has fallen
state: The FRN, the Kabila-led movement that replaced AFC-M23 in talks with Kinshasa, took Bulambika in Kalehe territory on 8 Nov after an offensive along the RN3 (Actualite.cd), and the army announced a counter-offensive as fighting spread beyond Kalehe (Africanews, 10 Nov). The FRN said on 4 Nov it had no intention of advancing on Uvira and remained committed to the Doha process (New Times). Searches on 18 Nov found no capture of Goma, Bukavu or Uvira or direct interstate fighting, so Watch holds.
for_you: Anyone travelling to eastern DR Congo should check FCDO travel advice. Those most exposed are civilians in Kalehe and nearby territories, where offensives tend to bring new waves of displacement.
rubric_hit: Watch: active fighting in South Kivu; no capture of a major city or direct interstate fighting (Alert line)
